notes.title: Nightmare Journey now has a demo!
notes.content:
[b]Nightmare Journey[/b] now has a [b]free demo![/b] You can play it now and see what the game is about. Explore the nightmares, try to escape, and experience the tension.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3598840/Nightmare_Journey_Demo/

[b]Demo content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Experience Normal Difficulty Mode (Easy and Insanity are available in the full game).
[*] Play up to 4,500 meters of the journey before the demo ends.
[*] Limited Nightmares – Experience a small selection of the nightmare sequences from the full game.
[/list]


We’d love to hear your thoughts, so feel free to leave [b]feedback[/b]!

notes.title: Wishlist Nightmare Journey Now!
notes.content:
[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3297730/Nightmare_Journey]Nightmare Journey[/url][/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3297730/Nightmare_Journey][img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3297730/header.jpg?t=1735741736[/img][/url]

[h2]About the game:[/h2]
You're on a bus, trying to reach the next station.

Each time you sleep, you must determine if you're awake or trapped in a nightmare.

Look for clues to figure out if you're still dreaming. Find a way to escape-but are you sure it's a nightmare?

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3297730/Nightmare_Journey][img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3297730/ss_ea9ae739c4df5174baea54ac4640dda87fa6a247.1920x1080.jpg?t=1735741736[/img][/url]

[h2]Difficulty Levels:[/h2]
        [b]Easy:[/b] More clues to help you identify nightmares, with forgiving escape attempts.
        [b]Normal:[/b] Balanced challenge, fewer clues, and higher risks if you make the wrong choice.
        [b]Nightmare:[/b] Minimal clues, relentless threats, and only the most resourceful players will survive.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3297730/Nightmare_Journey][img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3297730/ss_949b62ecbdc34e5e60b78ea6716b5d3cca6e7b82.600x338.jpg?t=1735741736[/img][/url]

[h2]Play Time:[/h2]
        30-60 minutes

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3297730/Nightmare_Journey][img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3297730/ss_ea9ae739c4df5174baea54ac4640dda87fa6a247.600x338.jpg?t=1735741736[/img][/url]
